content.text: Line 226 looks wrong: `=== undefined` sets photo to null. I'll check the surrounding code.

candidates.explanation: When the update DTO has no `photo` field (for example, a first-name-only edit), `updateUserDto.photo === undefined` is true. The code then sets `photo = null`, and that null is passed to the repository update. The mapper turns null into a null photo relation, so the avatar is cleared. The branch should only set null when the client explicitly sends `photo: null`. It matches the create path, which uses `=== null`.

fix.description: Change the condition at line 226 from `updateUserDto.photo === undefined` to `updateUserDto.photo === null`. An omitted photo then stays undefined and is left unchanged. Only an explicit null clears it.
